buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work The contractor shall be responsible for the complete supply, installation, erection, fitting, testing and com missioning of the Solar Powered Electric Fencing System covering approximately 500 metres of perimeter, including all required accessories, fittings, cables, earthing arrangements and associated materials. 2. Site Inspection The bidder shall inspect the proposed installation site before submission of the bid, wherever permitted, an d assess the site requirements, terrain conditions and installation feasibility. No additional payment shall b e admissible on account of inadequate assessment of site requirements. 3. Quality of Materials All materials supplied shall be new, unused, genuine and of standard quality. The materials shall conform t o the technical specifications stipulated in the bid. Substandard, defective or damaged materials shall be r ejected and replaced by the contractor at no additional cost. 4. Installation and Commissioning The complete fencing system shall be installed by technically qualified personnel. The contractor shall ens ure proper alignment of fencing posts, wire tensioning, electrical connections, solar panel installation and earthing arrangements. 5. Solar Energizer and Battery Compatibility The solar energizer, solar panel and rechargeable battery shall be fully compatible with each other. The sy stem shall be capable of operating through solar power with battery backup to ensure reliable functioning during periods of inadequate sunlight. 6. Safety Requirements

The electric fencing system shall incorporate appropriate safety features and shall comply with applicable electrical safety standards. The energizer shall deliver controlled electrical pulses and shall not cause leth al injury to humans or animals. Suitable warning signboards shall be installed at prominent locations. 7. Earthing Arrangement The contractor shall provide an adequate and effective earthing arrangement as per the manufacturer's re commendations to ensure proper functioning and safety of the fencing system. 8. Testing and Demonstration After completion of installation, the contractor shall conduct operational testing and demonstrate the satisf actory functioning of the complete system in the presence of the consignee/authorised representative. 9. Warranty The following minimum warranty shall be provided: (a) Solar Panel – 25 Years (performance warranty, with applicable product warranty separately specified). (b) Rechargeable Battery – 04 Years. (c) Solar Energizer – 01 Year. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and failures under normal operating conditions. 10. Defective Materials Any defective, damaged or non-functional component noticed during installation, testing or the warranty p eriod shall be repaired or replaced by the contractor without any additional financial liability to the Govern ment. 11. Training and Demonstration The contractor shall provide basic operational training to the nominated personnel regarding operation of t he energizer, battery maintenance, solar panel care, safety precautions and routine inspection of the fenci ng system. 12. Documentation The contractor shall hand over the following documents upon completion of installation: (a) Manufacturer's warranty certificates. (b) Operation and maintenance manual. (c) Technical specifications and user manual of the solar energizer, solar panel and battery. (d) Installation and commissioning report. 13. Site Clearance The contractor shall ensure proper disposal of packing materials, debris and other waste generated during installation. The installation site shall be handed over in a clean and satisfactory condition. 14. Completion Period The complete supply, installation, testing and commissioning of the Solar Powered Electric Fencing System shall be completed within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM contract. 15. Final Acceptance Final acceptance of the system shall be accorded only after successful installation, testing, demonstration and verification of compliance with the stipulated technical specifications by the consignee/authorised rep resentative. 16. Comprehensive Responsibility The contractor shall be solely responsible for the proper functioning of the complete fencing system, inclu ding all components, accessories and electrical connections supplied under the contract.
